construct: ITGB2 mutations cause deficiency of the beta-2 integrin subunit CD18, impairing leukocyte integrins such as LFA-1 and Mac-1. Neutrophils can roll but cannot undergo normal firm adhesion to endothelial ICAMs and subsequent recruitment into infected tissue.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Delayed umbilical-cord separation, neutrophilia, absent pus, recurrent bacterial infection, and low CD18 identify LAD-I; beta-2 integrin failure prevents firm neutrophil adhesion to endothelial ICAMs.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Selectin rolling, chemotaxis, PECAM-mediated diapedesis, and NADPH-oxidase killing are distinct steps. The explicit CD18 defect uniquely identifies beta-2-integrin-mediated firm adhesion as the failed step.
